notes: beIN Media Group (Digiturk) holds all domestic and international Süper Lig rights for 2024-25 to 2026-27 (2024 TFF tender, package E). 2026-27 is the last season of that deal, and a new tender is expected in 2026 for 2027-28 onward. In Turkey every match is exclusive to beIN SPORTS (Digiturk satellite, plus the TOD streaming service). No free-to-air live coverage was found. For international coverage, beIN SPORTS USA (beIN SPORTS CONNECT also serves Canada and Puerto Rico) is confirmed for 2026-27. beIN SPORTS France runs a 2026-27 Süper Lig section with in-match clips, but no explicit rights statement was found. No official TFF/beIN list of international sub-licensees was found. Other countries come from an unreferenced Turkish Wikipedia table (about 2025) and are flagged as unconfirmed. beIN says the league reaches 100+ locations worldwide; other reports say 40 countries.

channels.name: beIN SPORTS 1 / beIN SPORTS 2 / beIN SPORTS 4K (Digiturk)

broadcasters.note: All matches are exclusive to beIN SPORTS (2026-27 matchday 9 listings show beIN SPORTS 1, 2 and 4K). TOD is beIN's streaming platform, and beinsports.com.tr links its live matches to TOD's Süper Lig package. The deal runs through the end of 2026-27. No free-to-air live matches.
beIN SPORTS USA lists 2026-27 matches (e.g. Matchday 9) live on beIN SPORTS and beIN SPORTS CONNECT.
beIN states that fans in the US, Puerto Rico and Canada can watch 2026-27 matches on beIN SPORTS CONNECT.
